name: thekaiwa
description: TheKaiwa — DB 준비 단계 최소 패키지(Phase 0 스캐폴딩 전). Prisma 스키마 push 용도만.

scripts.db:generate: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma generate
scripts.db:push: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma db push --skip-generate
scripts.db:validate: bash scripts/sync-local.sh && cd $HOME/.node-local/thekaiwa && node node_modules/.bin/prisma validate
